per_case_results.question: What is the most common bond type?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM (SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) AS T
per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT "bond_type" FROM "bond" GROUP BY "bond_type" ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

per_case_results.question: Calculate the average number of oxygen atoms in single-bonded molecules.
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) FROM (SELECT T1.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.element) AS oxygen_count FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o' GROUP BY T1.molecule_id) AS oxygen_counts
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "a"."element" = 'o' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT "b"."molecule_id") FROM "bond" "b" INNER JOIN "atom" "a" ON "a"."molecule_id" = "b"."molecule_id" WHERE "b"."bond_type" = '-'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: On average how many carcinogenic molecules are single bonded?
per_case_results.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT T3.molecule_id, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS single_bond_count FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-' AND T3.label = '+' GROUP BY T3.molecule_id) AS subquery
per_case_results.actual_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN "b"."bond_type" = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT("a"."atom_id") FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" WHERE "m"."label" = '+'
LIMIT 500

per_case_results.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.

per_case_results.actual_sql: SELECT DISTINCT "m"."molecule_id" FROM "molecule" "m" INNER JOIN "bond" "b" ON "m"."molecule_id" = "b"."molecule_id" WHERE "b"."bond_type" = '#' AND "m"."label" = '+' LIMIT 100

per_case_results.question: What is the percentage of carbon in double-bond molecules?
